summary: Reliance Global Group completed the sale of 100% of Southwestern Montana Insurance Center, LLC to Scali, LLC dba Scali Insurance Group under a Purchase and Contribution Agreement effective September 1, 2026, with closing September 11. Cash consideration was $2,625,000, based on 8.75x pro forma EBITDA of $300,000, plus uncapped contingent consideration equal to 8.75x any EBITDA above $300,000 for the twelve months ending August 31, 2027, payable within 90 days post-anniversary and subordinated. Proceeds of $1,207,324.67 repaid Oak Street term-loan principal, releasing SMI liens. No material buyer relationships. Watch contingent-earnings achievement and buyer payment risk.
